question: Can I cast Forceful Denial targeting itself just to get its cascade?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you cannot cast Forceful Denial targeting itself just to cascade.
expected.answer: You can't cast Forceful Denial targeting itself just to cascade.

whyHard: Cascade triggers on cast, so players think any legal cast will do, but the spell needs another legal target.
